description: Stop a Klaviyo campaign that is scheduled or sending: action 'revert' puts it back to a draft (only before it goes), 'cancel' cancels it for good. Emails already delivered stay delivered. Without confirm:true nothing changes and you get what would happen. Free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).
name: cancel_klaviyo_campaign
title: Stop a Klaviyo campaign
